solutions.title: Boundary reachability matrix
solutions.strategy: Mark all O cells reachable from a boundary O in a separate matrix, then flip unmarked O cells.

timeComplexity.explanation: Boundary DFS and the final board pass together inspect each cell a constant number of times.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The safe-cell matrix stores one boolean per board cell, and DFS can also recurse through many cells.

solutions.title: In-place boundary marker
solutions.strategy: Temporarily mark boundary-connected O cells, flip the remaining O cells, then restore the marked cells.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each cell is visited by search or final normalization a constant number of times.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The board is marked in place, but recursive DFS can use stack space proportional to the number of connected O cells.
